User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account within the AQLI Digital application, storing core profile information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

username.description: The user's chosen username, used for login and display.

email.description: The user's email address, used for communication and account recovery.

profilePictureUrl.description: URL to the user's profile picture, if available.

roleId.description: Reference to the user's assigned role, defining permissions and access levels. (Relationship: Role 1:N User)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: Defines user roles and their associated permissions within the application, such as 'SuperAdmin', 'Admin', 'Learner', or 'Instructor'.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Role entity.

description.description: A detailed description of the role's purpose and permissions.

Sura.title: Sura
Sura.description: Represents a chapter (Sura) from the Quran, used for organizing recitation and learning materials.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Sura entity.

nameArabic.description: The name of the Sura in Arabic.

nameEnglish.description: The transliterated English name of the Sura.

suraNumber.description: The numerical order of the Sura in the Quran (e.g., 1 for Al-Fatiha).

ayahCount.description: The total number of verses (Ayahs) in the Sura.

revelationPlace.description: Indicates where the Sura was revealed (e.g., 'Meccan' or 'Medinan').

RecitationSession.title: RecitationSession
RecitationSession.description: Records details of a user's Quran recitation session with the AI Tilawah Assistant.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RecitationSession entity.

userId.description: Reference to the user who performed the recitation. (Relationship: User 1:N RecitationSession)

suraId.description: Reference to the Sura being recited, if applicable. (Relationship: Sura 1:N RecitationSession)

ayahStart.description: The starting Ayah number of the recitation segment.

ayahEnd.description: The ending Ayah number of the recitation segment.

startTime.description: Timestamp when the recitation session started.

endTime.description: Timestamp when the recitation session ended.

audioRecordingUrl.description: URL to the audio recording of the user's recitation.

overallScore.description: The overall score or proficiency rating given by the AI for the recitation session.

feedbackSummary.description: A summary of the AI-generated feedback for the entire recitation session.

RecitationFeedbackDetail.title: RecitationFeedbackDetail
RecitationFeedbackDetail.description: Stores granular feedback details for specific parts of a user's recitation within a session.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RecitationFeedbackDetail entity.

recitationSessionId.description: Reference to the parent recitation session. (Relationship: RecitationSession 1:N RecitationFeedbackDetail)

ayahNumber.description: The Ayah number to which this specific feedback pertains.

wordIndex.description: The index of the word within the Ayah, if feedback is word-specific.

feedbackText.description: Specific textual feedback for the particular segment (e.g., 'Incorrect pronunciation of Haa').

score.description: A score or rating for this specific part of the recitation.

startOffsetMs.description: Start timestamp in milliseconds within the audio recording for this feedback segment.

endOffsetMs.description: End timestamp in milliseconds within the audio recording for this feedback segment.

TajweedModule.title: TajweedModule
TajweedModule.description: Defines a high-level module for studying Tajweed rules, containing multiple lessons and quizzes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TajweedModule entity.

title.description: The title of the Tajweed module (e.g., 'Makharij al-Huruf').

description.description: A brief description of the module's content.

order.description: The display order of the module within the overall Tajweed curriculum.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the module is currently active and available to users.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the Tajweed module was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the Tajweed module was last updated.

TajweedLesson.title: TajweedLesson
TajweedLesson.description: Represents a single lesson within a Tajweed module, providing educational content.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TajweedLesson entity.

moduleId.description: Reference to the parent Tajweed module this lesson belongs to. (Relationship: TajweedModule 1:N TajweedLesson)

title.description: The title of the Tajweed lesson.

content.description: The main educational content of the lesson, possibly including text, images, or embedded media.

videoUrl.description: URL to an accompanying video for the lesson, if available.

order.description: The display order of the lesson within its module.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the Tajweed lesson was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the Tajweed lesson was last updated.

UserLessonProgress.title: UserLessonProgress
UserLessonProgress.description: Tracks a user's progress and completion status for individual Tajweed lessons.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserLessonProgress entity.

userId.description: Reference to the user whose progress is being tracked. (Relationship: User 1:N UserLessonProgress)

lessonId.description: Reference to the Tajweed lesson being tracked. (Relationship: TajweedLesson 1:N UserLessonProgress)

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the user has completed the lesson.

completionDate.description: Timestamp when the user completed the lesson, if applicable.

progressPercentage.description: The percentage of the lesson completed by the user (0-100).

lastAccessedAt.description: Timestamp when the user last accessed this lesson.

TajweedQuiz.title: TajweedQuiz
TajweedQuiz.description: Defines a quiz associated with a Tajweed lesson to test user understanding.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TajweedQuiz entity.

lessonId.description: Reference to the Tajweed lesson this quiz is associated with. (Relationship: TajweedLesson 1:N TajweedQuiz)

description.description: A brief description or instructions for the quiz.

passScore.description: The minimum score required to pass the quiz (e.g., 70 for 70%).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the Tajweed quiz was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the Tajweed quiz was last updated.

QuizQuestion.title: QuizQuestion
QuizQuestion.description: Represents a single question within a Tajweed quiz.

id.description: Unique identifier for the QuizQuestion entity.

quizId.description: Reference to the Tajweed quiz this question belongs to. (Relationship: TajweedQuiz 1:N QuizQuestion)

questionText.description: The text of the quiz question.

explanation.description: An explanation for the correct answer, shown after the quiz attempt.

order.description: The display order of the question within its quiz.

QuizOption.title: QuizOption
QuizOption.description: Represents an answer option for a multiple-choice quiz question.

id.description: Unique identifier for the QuizOption entity.

questionId.description: Reference to the quiz question this option belongs to. (Relationship: QuizQuestion 1:N QuizOption)

optionText.description: The text of the answer option.

isCorrect.description: Indicates whether this option is a correct answer for the question.

UserQuizAttempt.title: UserQuizAttempt
UserQuizAttempt.description: Records a user's attempt at completing a Tajweed quiz.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserQuizAttempt entity.

userId.description: Reference to the user who attempted the quiz. (Relationship: User 1:N UserQuizAttempt)

quizId.description: Reference to the Tajweed quiz that was attempted. (Relationship: TajweedQuiz 1:N UserQuizAttempt)

startTime.description: Timestamp when the user started the quiz attempt.

endTime.description: Timestamp when the user submitted or finished the quiz attempt.

score.description: The score obtained by the user in this quiz attempt.

isPassed.description: Indicates whether the user passed the quiz based on the passScore.

UserQuizAnswer.title: UserQuizAnswer
UserQuizAnswer.description: Stores a user's specific answer for a question within a quiz attempt.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserQuizAnswer entity.

userQuizAttemptId.description: Reference to the parent quiz attempt. (Relationship: UserQuizAttempt 1:N UserQuizAnswer)

questionId.description: Reference to the question answered. (Relationship: QuizQuestion 1:N UserQuizAnswer)

selectedOptionIds.description: References to the QuizOption(s) selected by the user for a multiple-choice question. (Relationship: QuizOption N:N UserQuizAnswer)

responseText.description: The user's free-form text response for fill-in-the-blank questions.

AIScholarQuestion.title: AIScholarQuestion
AIScholarQuestion.description: Records a question submitted by a user to the AI Scholar assistant.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AIScholarQuestion entity.

userId.description: Reference to the user who asked the question. (Relationship: User 1:N AIScholarQuestion)

questionText.description: The full text of the question submitted by the user.

askTime.description: Timestamp when the question was submitted.

category.description: The category of the question (e.g., 'Tajwid', 'Tafsir', 'Islamic History').

AIScholarAnswer.title: AIScholarAnswer
AIScholarAnswer.description: Stores the AI-generated answer to a user's question, potentially with human verification.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AIScholarAnswer entity.

questionId.description: Reference to the question this is an answer for. (Relationship: AIScholarQuestion 1:N AIScholarAnswer)

answerText.description: The full text of the AI-generated answer.

answerTime.description: Timestamp when the answer was generated or last updated.

sourceReferences.description: List of textual or URL references used by the AI to formulate the answer.

isVerified.description: Indicates if a human scholar has reviewed and verified the accuracy of the answer.

AIScholarSource.title: AIScholarSource
AIScholarSource.description: Represents a piece of curated, verified knowledge used as a source for the AI Scholar.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AIScholarSource entity.

title.description: The title or name of the source material.

content.description: The full text or key excerpts of the source material.

category.description: The category of knowledge this source belongs to (e.g., 'Tajwid', 'Tafsir', 'Islamic History').

author.description: The author or compiler of the source material.

publishDate.description: The publication date of the source material.

verifiedByUserId.description: Reference to the user (e.g., an Admin or Scholar) who verified this source. (Relationship: User 1:N AIScholarSource)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the source was added to the knowledge base.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the source was last updated in the knowledge base.

StudyCircle.title: StudyCircle
StudyCircle.description: Defines an online learning group, or 'halaqa', facilitated by certified instructors.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyCircle entity.

name.description: The name of the study circle.

description.description: A description of the study circle's focus or curriculum.

instructorId.description: Reference to the certified instructor leading the study circle. (Relationship: User 1:N StudyCircle)

maxMembers.description: The maximum number of participants allowed in the study circle.

startDate.description: The date when the study circle is scheduled to begin.

endDate.description: The date when the study circle is scheduled to end.

status.description: The current status of the study circle (e.g., 'upcoming', 'active', 'completed', 'cancelled').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the study circle was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the study circle was last updated.

StudyCircleEnrollment.title: StudyCircleEnrollment
StudyCircleEnrollment.description: Records a user's enrollment in a specific study circle, facilitating N:N relationships between users and study circles.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyCircleEnrollment entity.

studyCircleId.description: Reference to the study circle the user is enrolled in. (Relationship: StudyCircle 1:N StudyCircleEnrollment)

userId.description: Reference to the user enrolled in the study circle. (Relationship: User 1:N StudyCircleEnrollment)

enrolledAt.description: Timestamp when the user enrolled in the study circle.

role.description: The role of the user within this specific study circle (e.g., 'Participant', 'Moderator').

StudyCircleMeeting.title: StudyCircleMeeting
StudyCircleMeeting.description: Details scheduled meetings for a study circle, including links and recordings.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyCircleMeeting entity.

studyCircleId.description: Reference to the parent study circle. (Relationship: StudyCircle 1:N StudyCircleMeeting)

title.description: The title or topic of the meeting.

agenda.description: The agenda or planned discussion points for the meeting.

meetingTime.description: The scheduled date and time for the meeting.

durationMinutes.description: The planned duration of the meeting in minutes.

meetingLink.description: The URL or link to join the online meeting.

recordingUrl.description: URL to the recording of the meeting, if available.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the meeting record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the meeting record was last updated.

Donation.title: Donation
Donation.description: Records details of user donations to the AQLI Digital platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Donation entity.

userId.description: Reference to the user who made the donation, if not anonymous. (Relationship: User 1:N Donation)

transactionId.description: A unique transaction identifier provided by the payment gateway.

paymentMethod.description: The method used for the donation (e.g., 'Credit Card', 'PayPal', 'Bank Transfer').

donationDate.description: Timestamp when the donation was made.

isAnonymous.description: Indicates whether the donor chose to remain anonymous.

message.description: An optional message or dedication from the donor.

status.description: The current status of the donation transaction (e.g., 'completed', 'pending', 'failed').

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed following the core principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and DBAC, ensuring a secure, scalable, and debuggable system. The primary goal is to simplify Firestore Security Rules by making authorization context explicit within documents and paths, thereby avoiding complex and inefficient `get()` operations.

**Authorization Independence (Denormalization Strategy):**
1.  **Path-Based Ownership:** For user-specific data (e.g., `RecitationSession`, `UserLessonProgress`, `UserQuizAttempt`, `AIScholarQuestion`), data is nested under `/users/{userId}/...`. The `userId` in the path directly asserts ownership, meaning a `get()` call to a parent user document is unnecessary to verify that `request.auth.uid` matches the owner.
2.  **Nested Data Ownership:** For subcollections like `RecitationFeedbackDetail` (under `recitation_sessions`) or `UserQuizAnswer` (under `quiz_attempts`), ownership is implicitly inherited from the parent document's path (`/users/{userId}/...`). This means the `request.auth.uid` must match the `{userId}` wildcard in the path, ensuring atomic authorization without additional `get()` calls.
3.  **Collaborative Data (Denormalized Instructor ID):** For `StudyCircleEnrollment` and `StudyCircleMeeting`, which belong to a `StudyCircle`, access control depends on the `StudyCircle`'s `instructorId`. To achieve authorization independence, the `instructorId` from the parent `StudyCircle` document *MUST* be denormalized and copied into each `StudyCircleEnrollment` and `StudyCircleMeeting` document. This allows rules to check `request.auth.uid == resource.data.instructorId` directly on the document without needing to `get()` the parent `StudyCircle` document.

**QAPs (Query as a Point of Security) Strategy:**
1.  **User-Owned Collections:** Collections like `/users/{userId}/recitation_sessions` inherently support QAPs for list operations. A user can only `list` documents under their own `userId` path, automatically filtering for owned data.
2.  **Global Content Collections:** Collections such as `/suras`, `/tajweed_modules`, and `/ai_scholar_sources` are designed for broad public read access, making QAPs straightforward (`allow list: true;`). Write access is strictly limited to authenticated administrators or superadministrators.
3.  **Collaborative Collections (`StudyCircle`):** `/study_circles` can be listed by all users for discovery. More granular access (e.g., viewing meetings, managing enrollments) relies on the denormalized `instructorId` or membership status, which can be checked efficiently within rules for specific document reads.
4.  **Donations:** The `/donations` collection is a root collection. To support user-specific listing while allowing admin access to all, security rules will require that a `list` query from a non-admin user must include a `where('userId', '==', request.auth.uid)` filter. This enforces QAP by ensuring users only retrieve their own donation records, while administrators can query freely.

**DBAC (Database Access Control):**
Admin and SuperAdmin roles are implemented using marker collections: `/roles_superadmin/{superadminId}` and `/roles_admin/{adminId}`. A user's admin status is determined by the existence of a document matching their `uid` in these collections. This allows for extremely simple, atomic, and high-performance role checks in security rules (e.g., `get(/databases/$(database)/documents/roles_superadmin/$(request.auth.uid)).exists()`). This directly addresses the requirement for an 'admin-specific sidebar menu' and 'superadmin account' by providing a robust and debuggable mechanism for role-based access control.
